subject: a wooden nautilus character
art_direction: 蜂蜜木纹鹦鹉螺壳向一侧展开，深青小脑袋从低处探出。
visible_description: 蜂蜜木纹鹦鹉螺壳向一侧展开，深青小脑袋从低处探出。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Turn a nautilus shell from honey-colored wood with a single broad spiral groove. A small dark-teal enamel head peeks from the lower opening, showing reserved contentment through two neat eye marks. Angle the shell gently and keep the tentacle-like feet short. Grazing light follows the wood grain against a pale cool-gray studio field. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
